title: Title
description: Fiori heading with semantic level (H1–H6) independent of visual size.

usage.summary: Name pages and sections with explicit heading semantics.
useWhen: Help users understand the structure of a page by naming its sections.
Use level for the semantic H1–H6 hierarchy and size for visual emphasis independently.

avoidWhen.when: Show body prose without heading semantics.
Identify a business object using a primary name and supporting identifier.
Label an input or form field rather than name a section.
